acceptance.reason: real efficacy data unavailable; no CASCADE run to judge
acceptance.note: CASCADE must at least tie the ridge/linear baseline on Pearson and beat the global-mean predictor on MSE on the real Huesken test split, on every seed (conservative aggregate). Simple baselines are a hard bar: deep efficacy/perturbation models often fail to beat them (Ahlmann-Eltze et al., Nat Methods 2025).
